notes.submission: Pointer clicks and Enter use Playwright Chromium input; submit handlers preventDefault for local interaction cases and capture SubmitEvent.submitter plus FormData(form, submitter). The GET and POST forms are allowed to navigate only to request-capturing endpoints on this same 127.0.0.1 Vite server.
notes.sanitizer: Every HTML control is first produced by the fixed web source's renderMarkdown() DOMPurify path. Attribute snapshots include null for attributes removed by sanitization.
notes.textarea: Textarea source contains LF newlines. The control value and FormData entries expose LF, while browser GET and POST serialization normalizes them to CRLF.
notes.keyboard: Enter cases dispatch real Chromium keyboard input after focusing each field; they are not requestSubmit() calls.
notes.screenshot: The capture script also saves 390x844 light and dark screenshots immediately after a real click on an invalid required form.
